label: Epistemic luck
learning_takeaway: Distinguish an accidentally correct justified belief from reliable epistemic success.
support_note: The Gettier discussion explicitly identifies truth through luck as the unresolved problem.

label: Overjustification effect
learning_takeaway: Examine when expected external rewards can reduce interest in an enjoyable activity.
support_note: The text qualifies effects by tangible versus verbal rewards and expectation.

label: Resultant moral luck
learning_takeaway: Separate luck in consequences from luck in an agent's situation or character.
support_note: Driver and would-be murderer pairs isolate luck in how events turn out.
